purpose: Diagnose ambiguous installed METADATA selection before another original GPU attempt
network: Exact locked files.pythonhosted.org wheel URL and its PEP658 sidecar only; one streamed wheel at a time; no install/import/execute/extract
results: All57 wheel archives authenticated; exact top-level owner METADATA compared with immutable PEP658 hash and dependency fields; all old ambiguous selector candidates reported
limits: Old verifier error conflates metadata candidate count and byte mismatch; no byte mismatch is established by that log alone.
An audit passes only if all wheel owner METADATA hashes and dependency fields match; byte differences remain explicit rejection.
Vendored METADATA inventory is diagnostic; it cannot replace exact owner METADATA identity.
Installation rewriting is not measured by archive-only audit; no environment guard or payload pin is changed.
